# Senior-role test set — AIRS deterministic layer

One senior JD and eight synthetic resumes. All people, companies and institutions are invented; contact details use `example.invalid`. "Present" means October 2026.

This set replaces the deleted real campaign as the senior-role test case and becomes part of the Phase 4 golden set, alongside the Phase 3 and hard-negative sets.

---

## 1. Instructions for Claude Code

- Create `tests/fixtures/senior/jd_senior.docx` and `S1.docx` … `S8.docx`, text exactly as written, simple formatting.
- Create `tests/fixtures/senior/expectations.json` from section 5 (fields: id, tests, expected_outcome, expected_core, reason, trap).
- Make one zip, `senior_S1-S8.zip` (git-ignored).
- Keep this file as `tests/fixtures/senior/README.md`. Add a builder in `scripts/fixtures/` like the other two sets. Commit on its own branch and merge into RMe.
- Synthetic data only. No email.

---

## 2. JD — Head of Data & AI Platforms

**Head of Data & AI Platforms**
Meridian Retail Group · Bengaluru · Full-time

**About the role**
We are looking for a senior leader to own our data and AI platforms end to end: the data platform that feeds analytics and machine learning, the tooling that takes models to production, and the team that builds and runs them.

**Experience**
Minimum 12 years in data or software engineering, including at least 5 years leading engineering teams.

**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field preferred. Equivalent experience is considered.

**Must-have skills**
- Data Engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse design)
- Machine Learning (taking models from prototype to production)
- MLOps (model deployment, monitoring, retraining, feature stores)
- Cloud Architecture (AWS or Azure)

**Good to have**
- Databricks
- Apache Spark
- Python
- Data Governance
- Kubernetes
- Stakeholder Management

**Nice to have**
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect
- Budget ownership above ₹10 crore

**Responsibilities**
- Lead a team of 30+ data, ML and platform engineers
- Own the architecture of the lakehouse and ML platform
- Put ML models into production and keep them healthy
- Work with business leaders to prioritise data and AI investments

## 4. Calibration settings

- **Profile template:** Experienced (internships don't count; listed-only skills can't be confirmed; education Preferred).
- **Role domain:** Data (or the closest available option).
- **Core (4, so 1 may be missing):** Data Engineering (**required**), Machine Learning, MLOps, Cloud Architecture.
- **Supporting:** Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, Data Governance, Kubernetes, Stakeholder Management.
- **Preferred:** AWS Certified Solutions Architect (if extracted), budget ownership (skip if not extracted).
- **Minimum experience:** 12 years; tolerance blank (default max(1, 10%) = 1.2 years).
- **Education:** Preferred.

---

## 5. Expected outcomes

| ID | Tests | Expected | Expected core | Reason | Trap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Strong fit | PASS | 4/4 | Every core skill shown in delivered work; 15 years | None; baseline |
| S2 | Near-miss on experience | HOLD | 4/4 | All core shown; 11 years against 12, within the 1.2-year tolerance | MLOps only in the skills list, but shown in work ("deployed… with monitoring and scheduled retraining") |
| S3 | Required skill missing | HOLD | 3/4 | Strong ML, MLOps and cloud; no data engineering. Data Engineering is required, so one near-miss → HOLD | Risk: ML pipelines read as Data Engineering → PASS |
| S4 | Adjacent field (BI/ERP) | REJECT | 2/4 (Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture) | Real warehousing and an Azure migration, but no ML or MLOps | "Predictive dashboards for sales forecasting" read as Machine Learning → HOLD |
| S5 | Titles without substance; listed-only skills | REJECT | 0/4 | Senior titles and a skills list naming all four core skills, but no work line shows any of them | Listed-only skills must stay uncertain under Experienced; "Chief Data & AI Officer" title lines must not count as evidence |
| S6 | Advised, never delivered | HOLD | 0–4 uncertain | Relevant expertise, but every line is advisory ("advised", "assessed", "recommended"); a person should judge | Votes may confirm advisory lines as the skills → PASS |
| S7 | No degree, 20 years | PASS | 4/4 | Education is Preferred, so a diploma never rejects; every core skill shown | Education wrongly treated as a gate → REJECT |
| S8 | Senior engineer, wrong specialty | REJECT | 2/4 (Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture) | Strong backend leader; Kafka pipelines and AWS architecture, but no ML or MLOps | Kafka services read as ML-adjacent; low risk |
